svg.title: Moving and resizing in Zonogy. Dragging a window onto another zone moves it there, and the window in that zone takes its place. Dragging the bar between two zones resizes them, and their windows follow. A window that can't shrink to its zone runs off the display's edge, and slides fully into view while it is in use.
svg.text: Drag a window onto another zone: the two windows swap
Drag the bar between zones to resize them
A window too big for its zone slides into view while you use it
